migrations.name: 2026_10_03_01_migration_ledger
migrations.summary: Schema app_private and the ledger app_private.app_migrations(name, applied_at) that every later migration signs.

migrations.name: 2026_10_03_02_rpc_auth_null_guard
migrations.summary: adopt_swap, adopt_skip, decline_promote_request, approve_program and send_back_program refuse a caller without a user id; the two push warnings of the program-submit loop read as in production.

migrations.name: 2026_10_11_03_function_grants_lockdown
migrations.summary: No function of public is executable by anon or PUBLIC; a signed-in user executes an allow-list of 19 (the 12 helpers the policies call, the 7 RPCs the app calls); a function postgres creates later starts closed; all 36 functions run with search_path = public, pg_temp.

migrations.name: 2026_10_11_04_logged_history_guards
migrations.summary: A logged set (set_log_is_logged: done, failed, skipped, an RPE or an actual) or one with a video cannot be deleted, directly or by a cascade, from set_logs up to programs; exercise_slots.sets cannot go below one; a signed-in user's edit leaves the targets of a logged set as they were; adopt_swap and adopt_skip leave alone a slot with a logged set, a video or a comment; SET LOCAL app.allow_history_delete = 'on' lets a statement without a user id through.

migrations.name: 2026_10_11_05_students_role_gate
migrations.summary: No signed-in user inserts or deletes a students row, and none moves its link; every row written, by anyone, links a profile with the role coach to another one with the role student; exercise_library rows are added and edited by a coach only (is_coach()); the exercise of a slot and the substitute of a swap come from the library of the program's coach. The migration refuses to run (SLM05) while a link the gate would refuse exists.

migrations.name: 2026_10_11_06_pin_student_writes
migrations.summary: An athlete's own update of a set leaves its targets, its exercise, its number and is_student_added as they were; a session of a draft program carries no reviewed_at, archived_at, performed_at or scheduled_date, whoever writes it, and approve_program clears the four on the sessions of the program it approves; the author of a draft cannot change submitted_at once it is set.

migrations.name: 2026_10_11_07_profile_rules
migrations.summary: A new account gets a profile whose name is never empty: the name it was created with, else the part of its e-mail address before the @, else 'Athlete'; profiles.role stays what it was for a request that carries a user id and is written for one that does not (the SQL editor, the service-role key), except against a coach-athlete link: an athlete with a coach is not made a coach, a coach with athletes does not stop being one.

migrations.name: 2026_10_12_08_session_write_gates
migrations.summary: An athlete writes a set, a note on an exercise, a swap or a skip, and the video of a set — its row and its file — only in a session of the block being trained that the coach has neither archived nor reviewed (session_writable, session_writable_for_slot); reading stays open; a video is stored at <athlete>/<exercise slot of its set>/, so an account nobody coaches uploads nothing and nobody uploads under another athlete's exercise. A confirmed session that is not reviewed yet is still written.

migrations.name: 2026_10_13_09_review_lifecycle
migrations.summary: An athlete changes or takes back a confirmation only while its session is neither archived nor reviewed, and not while the review is being written; a signed-in user marks a session as reviewed, or sends feedback on it, only once its athlete has confirmed it (session_is_confirmed) — sessions reviewed without a confirmation before stay as they are and can still be confirmed; a confirmation, a swap or a skip that is taken back takes its unread coach notifications with it, and the ones that are stale today are deleted; the push of a confirmation is tagged by session.

migrations.name: 2026_10_13_10_goals_fk_coach_links
migrations.summary: A library exercise that a goal is set on cannot be deleted, nor the profile of a coach while an athlete is linked to it or a goal names it (goals.exercise_id, goals.coach_id and students.coach_id are ON DELETE RESTRICT); exercise_library has archived_at, which nothing reads yet; a coach reads the progress of a goal only while they coach its athlete (coach_profile_for_goal follows the link); transfer_student(athlete, new coach) moves the link and the athlete's goals together, for the owner of the database and the service role only.

migrations.name: 2026_10_13_11_activate_reorder_rpcs
migrations.summary: Three functions a signed-in user calls with the rights they already have (SECURITY INVOKER): activate_program(program) switches the athlete's other programs off and this one on in one statement, and refuses a draft and a program in the trash; reorder_sessions(phase, ids) and reorder_weeks(program, ids) renumber every session of a phase (0 to n-1) or every phase of a program (1 to n) in the order of the list, and refuse a list that is not exactly the children of the parent, archived sessions included. Nothing else: no table, no policy, no row.

migrations.name: 2026_10_13_12_copy_rpcs
migrations.summary: Four functions a signed-in user calls with the rights they already have (SECURITY INVOKER), each of which makes a whole copy or none: duplicate_session(session, title suffix) puts the copy right after its source; copy_sessions(ids, phase) adds one copy per entry at the end of a phase; duplicate_week(phase, program, label suffix) adds the phase with its sessions as the last phase of a program; duplicate_program(program, athlete, name suffix) makes an inactive block for the athlete or for another one of the coach. A copy is the prescription only — the targets of the sets, nothing that was trained — and leaves out, and counts, an exercise that is not in the library of the coach it is made for. Nothing else: no table, no policy, no row.
